name: 2C-P
addictionPotential: Low potential for abuse and dependence
summary: A synthetic phenylethlyamine that is sometimes compared in effects to 2C-E, yet with a much longer duration. With a much more pronouced bodyload. Is one of the most potent of the 2C-X series.
saferUse: Redosing within 3 hours is strongly warned against, and first-time users are advised to stay at or below the moderate category. Accurate volumetric measurement is recommended, as is avoiding visual estimation and non-oral routes, and using harm-reduction measures. The dose table is educational, not a recommendation.
metabolism: What is known about how the body handles this is very limited. No the enzymes involved, metabolites or pathway have been identified.
